text:
eve_finance: FYI got a weird adjustment on AWS Marketplace invoice INV-2026-0423 for Channel partner CloudWave. There's a negative adjustment line that looks like it's applying a different pricing band than our contract. Can someone take a look?

 tom_ops: on it — do we have the invoice PDF or the usage CSV? need the exact line items.

 anna_sales: this is CloudWave's reseller account (reseller_id RW-7782). Contract says Pricing band B (10-49 seats) — unit price $0.09/token. they shouldn't be down-tiered to band A.

 raj_aws: I see an AWS Marketplace fee adjustment on their partner consolidation report: "Marketplace Fee Adjustment" with a negative amount. AWS sometimes applies marketplace-level reconciliations when entitlements are reclassified. can someone paste the invoice lines?

 leo_engineer: pasting the relevant CSV snippet we extracted from the billing export:```
invoice_id,sku,description,units,unit_price,total
INV-2026-0423,MW-RESELLER-001,Redwood Inference - generation tokens,1200000,0.06,72000.00
INV-2026-0423,MW-RESELLER-001,Marketplace Fee Adjustment,-1,0.00,-1234.56
INV-2026-0423,MW-RESELLER-001,Reseller Discount Credit,-1,0.00,-5400.00
```

 eve_finance: thanks. the adjustment of -1234.56 is the weird one — our internal invoice should show the discounted unit_price; the adjustment shouldn't change the pricing band. did AWS send a credit note?

 tom_ops: checking our billing reports now against AWS consolidated bill. aws console shows an automatic "Marketplace Fee Adjustment" for the month. i'm opening a support case with AWS Marketplace Billing. will include entitlement ID and CSV.

 aws-billing-bot: Support case created: CASE-60321472. Subject: "Marketplace Fee Adjustment causing pricing band misalignment for reseller RW-7782". AWS response ETA: 72 hours.

 anna_sales: do we want to absorb the credit for now or invoice CloudWave for the difference? if AWS corrects, we'd reverse.

 eve_finance: don't absorb yet. request correction from AWS first. if AWS won't reverse, we should prepare a chargeback to CloudWave for the net price delta and loop legal. also need to validate revenue recognition impact for Apr 2026.

 leo_engineer: noted — i flagged the usage pipeline to keep a copy of raw usage and reconciliation diff. attaching internal ticket BN-4872 for audit trail.

 raj_aws: I'll follow up with my AWS contact to escalate; mention CASE-60321472 and ask for entitlement-level audit.

 tom_ops: copied. i'll post updates here once AWS replies. thanks all. :thumbsup:

 eve_finance: thanks. tagging @anna_sales @raj_aws @leo_engineer. please keep any CloudWave comms to the minimum until we have AWS confirmation.

 anna_sales: ack, will hold off external comms.

 aws-billing-bot: Payment reversal notice: credit applied $-1,234.56 to INV-2026-0423 (auto-generated).

 tom_ops: saw the bot notice. CASE-60321472 updated with the payment reversal details.

 eve_finance: closing loop here — if AWS confirms it's their reconciliation error we'll request a corrected invoice and reverse the marketplace adjustment. otherwise we'll prepare partner chargeback. will update by end of week.

 anna_sales: on it.
